messages:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a lightweight onboarding bench for halley-4b (fp16 -> q4v2) on a 1k prompt mix? Target p99 < 350ms for 256 tokens. Need throughput/latency/cost ballpark and memory headroom. Prompt set: https://s3.redwood/team/halley/onboard-prompts.json
kevin: I can run a smoke tonight. Which runtime path do you want (triton vs torchscript)? note KV cache warmup changes numbers a lot.
maria: Triton if available; otherwise default. Use KV warmup = 1k tokens. Also test batch sizes [1,4,8].
kevin: launching on ded-gpu-pool-3 with quant-profile halley-q4v2. Will post brief summary + raw logs when done.
ops-bot: deploy started by kevin on node node-52gpu, job id j-4623456790 
dana: quick cost ask — include a per-256-token cost estimate and peak GPU memory in the summary pls.
kevin: results are in, paste summary below:

```
model: halley-4b
config: fp16->q4v2
hw: A10G x1
seq: 256
batching tested: [1,4,8]
throughput (req/s): b=1 -> 18.2, b=4 -> 52.5, b=8 -> 88.0
latency p50 (ms): b1 10, b4 28, b8 65
latency p95 (ms): b1 120, b4 220, b8 340
latency p99 (ms): b1 260, b4 420, b8 690
gpu mem peak: 9.3GB
cpu mem peak: 1.1GB
kv warmup hit rate: 98% (1k warmup tokens)
cost est: ~$0.0045 per 256-token request (raw estimate)
notes: KV cache dramatically reduced tail latency; single-A10G handles fp16->q4v2 well.
```

kevin: full logs + perf traces uploaded to s3://redwood-onboard/halley/4623456789/ and dashboard link: https://console.redwood/models/halley-4b/bench/4623456789
dana: p99=260ms at batch=1 looks good and meets the <350ms target. b4/b8 exceed SLO so recommend default batch=1 and allow burst to 4 for throughput. :thumbsup:
sahil: did you run with KV enabled for the main run? that p99 delta between b1 and b4/8 seems KV-related.
kevin: yes main run had KV enabled. I re-ran one test with KV disabled — p99 b1 jumped to ~480ms, so KV is the driver.
lucy: will update the onboarding doc with recommended profile: quant=q4v2, default batch=1, kv warmup=1k, fallback quant=q8 for memory-constrained infra. I'll also add a note about p99 monitoring and eviction alerts.
maria: great — can you also add a canary config for Dedicated (scale 3, batch cap 4) and alerts for p99 > 350ms and kv evictions?
lucy: on it, creating INF-1423 to track canary + dashboard.
kevin: FYI I also tried a tiny tiling tweak, reduced kernel tile from 128->96 and saw slight p95 improvement for b4. Logged in traces folder.
maria: awesome work, thanks everyone :rocket:
